source_evidence: These titles are not all the same and do not necessarily mean better service for you.
question: Misconception: If an investment professional has initials after their name, that means they are more qualified and will provide better service.
answer: Initials alone do not show that an investment professional is more qualified or will provide better service. Titles can differ, and some may indicate limits on the products the professional can sell. Check what the title means rather than assuming it guarantees better service.
